description_en: Retrieves the execution status of a specified code block
description_zh: 获取指定代码块的执行状态
name: GetSparkStatement

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the code block in the Spark job
parameters.help_zh: 此Spark作业中代码块的唯一id
parameters.name: statement_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the Spark job
parameters.name: job_id

Data.description_en: The execution status of the code block
Data.description_zh: 描述了此段代码块的执行状态

CompletedTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp in milliseconds when the code execution ended
CompletedTime.description_zh: 代码执行结束的毫秒级时间戳

Id.description_en: The unique increment ID of the code block in the Spark job
Id.description_zh: 代码块在此Spark作业中的唯一递增id

Output.description_en:
The execution result of the code block. The result is a JSON-formatted string with the following structure:

status: the execution status.
execution_count: the line number of the code block that is currently being executed.
data: the code execution result
Output.description_zh:
代码块的执行结果, 执行结果是一个JSON格式的字符串, 其结构如下

status执行状态
execution_count当前执行到此代码块的哪一行
data代码执行结果

Process.description_en: The current execution progress of the code block. The value is a floating-point number. `1` indicates 100% completion, and `0.5` indicates 50% completion
Process.description_zh: 代码当前执行进度, 为浮点数,`1`代表100%执行完成, `0.5` 代表执行了50%

StartedTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp in milliseconds when the code execution started
StartedTime.description_zh: 代码开始执行的毫秒级时间戳

State.description_en:
The execution status of the code block. Valid values:

waiting: waiting for execution.
running: currently executing.
available: execution completed.
error: execution failed.
cancelling: attempting to stop.
cancelled: execution stopped
State.description_zh:
代码块的执行状态, 可能的状态有

waiting 等待执行
running 正在还行
available 执行完成
error 执行失败
cancelling 在尝试终止
cancelled 已经终止执行

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
